arrangement.notes: Sample-based arrangement featuring a textured bed layer with one-shot hits organized into channels named after common sample slicing techniques such as 'Transient', 'Slice', 'Chop', and 'Hit'. The energy profile follows a cinematic rise and fall pattern.
